onboarding_2.description: Create and reconnect to a digital wallet using new identification methods:
onboarding_2.icloud_note: Identification is done automatically using the access key linked to your iCloud account.

onboarding_3.confirm_checkboxes: Check all the boxes to confirm you understand the importance of access keys.
onboarding_3.checkbox_1: On your phone, go to 'Settings > Your Account > iCloud' and activate 'Passwords and Keychain' (not 1Password), to enable access keys.
onboarding_3.checkbox_2: Access keys allow you to recover the wallet in the future, in case of loss or replacement of your device.
onboarding_3.checkbox_3: Important: if your access key is deleted (and not backed up elsewhere), you lose access to the wallet and funds.
